difficulty_overhaul.mode.peaceful.info: No hostile mobs spawn and only some neutral mobs spawn. Hunger bar doesn't deplete and health replenishes over time.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.casual.info: Hostile mobs spawn but deal half damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.easy.info: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.normal.info: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.advanced.info: Hostile mobs deal 25% more damage and have more health. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.hard.info: Hostile mobs deal 50% more damage and have more health. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.expert.info: Hostile mobs deal 75% more damage, have more health, and wear tougher armor. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.master.info: Hostile mobs deal double damage and have double health. Their armor shrugs off your blows. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.grandmaster.inf: Hostile mobs deal 2.25x damage and have 2.25x health. Their armor is nearly impenetrable. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
difficulty_overhaul.mode.god.info: The world itself fights back. Mobs deal 2.5x damage, their armor is unbreakable, and hunger never rests. Only the worthy survive.
difficulty_overhaul.commands.invalid_mod: Unknown difficulty mode. Valid modes: peaceful, casual, easy, normal, advanced, hard, expert, master, grandmaster, god
